title: Occupancy-driven slew-rate limiter and safety cap for Dedicated fleet provisioning
author: Priya Malhotra
description: Motivation: recent incidents showed rapid concurrent provisioning from multiple pools can oversubscribe backend allocation and transiently spike GPU procurement costs. This PR introduces an occupancy-driven slew-rate limiter plus a safety cap to slow provisioning when the fleet approaches unstable saturation. Design: compute per-pool occupancy as a 60s EWMA of active reserved slots / pool capacity; derive a desired provisioning velocity from occupancy delta (target_slew = base_rate * (1 - occupancy)). A global safety_cap parameter clamps concurrent provisioning jobs per-cluster and decays as utilization trends down. The controller applies the limiter at the admission point for Dedicated provision requests and during scale-up reconciliation. Implementation: new package pkg/autoscaler implements SlewLimiter with tunable parameters (base_rate, min_interval, decay_halflife). ProvisionController consults limiter before enqueuing scale actions. We add a lightweight occupancy exporter for visibility and a new operational doc. Rollout: behind feature-flag "occupancy_slew_v1" default off; staged rollout to canary fleets, then 25% of dedicated clusters, full rollout after 2 weeks of telemetry validation. Backwards compatibility: when flag is off, behavior unchanged. Testing: unit tests for limiter math and e2e stability test that simulates simultaneous ramp-ups from 10 tenants. Metrics: new metrics cluster_slew_rate, pool_occupancy_ewma, provisioning_in_flight, safety_cap_active. Expected outcome: smoother scale-ups, reduced simultaneous allocation churn, bounded cost spikes. Notes: this is focused on admission-time rate control rather than persistent quota changes; follow-up PR planned to integrate with reservation watermarks once validated.

review_comments: Ethan Cole: Can you clarify the EWMA window selection? Why 60s and not 30s or 120s? Please add a note in the doc about tuning impact.
Priya Malhotra: Responded: 60s was chosen as a balance between responsiveness and noise for rapid tenant bursts; added tuning guidance and a short sensitivity graph to docs.
María Alvarez: Suggest adding a circuit-breaker metric when safety_cap blocks provisioning so operators can create alerting thresholds.
Priya Malhotra: Responded: added provisioning_in_flight and safety_cap_active metrics; included recommended alert thresholds in runbook.
Jun Park: Code nit: rename limiter.Allow() -> limiter.RequestToken(ctx) to make side effects explicit. Tests mostly look good.
Priya Malhotra: Responded: renamed API and updated callers.

release_notes: Introduce occupancy-driven slew-rate limiter to smooth Dedicated fleet scale-ups.
Add global safety cap to limit concurrent provisioning and avoid transient oversubscription.
Expose pool_occupancy_ewma and provisioning_in_flight metrics; update dedicated chart values to allow toggling behavior via feature flag.
Operational runbook added with tuning guidance and alert thresholds.
